title: Federation from matrix.org to half-shot.uk taken out for several hours due tombstone event (and subsequent membership spam) in room.
body:
I had a federation outage with matrix.org today, where messages from matrix.org arrived extremely late. On closer inspection, the worker assigned to handle inbound federation was totally hosed CPU-wise trying to deal with extremely large transactions.

The previous transaction seemed to run okay:
